clue.text: Theme of one book ignored by cheap BBC production

explanation.definitionFit: The composer is the subject of the whole puzzle, so he is literally its theme, as the preamble's anniversary hints.

explanation.definitionFit: The Solfeggietto was written in this minor key, so the key of entry 18 names the tonality.
